belief_statement: One possibility is that environmental inefficiency knowledge lack has inconsistent effects on window view, but the evidence is limited (2 findings, 2 studies). Further research is needed.

mechanisms.pathway: environmental inefficiency knowledge lack → [unknown mechanism] → window view

latent_variables.name: Individual sensitivity differences
latent_variables.rationale: High heterogeneity (high) across findings suggests an unmeasured individual-difference variable moderates the effect of environmental inefficiency knowledge lack on window view.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Pre-screening for trait sensitivity or prior exposure

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of environmental inefficiency knowledge lack, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of environmental inefficiency knowledge lack on window view replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is low. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What moderates the effect of environmental inefficiency knowledge lack on window view?
